Done. The **Profit Margin %** column has been added to `sales_data.xlsx`.

## What was added

- **`H1`**: Header "Profit Margin %" — styled to match the existing header (bold, light blue fill)
- **`H2:H9`**: Excel formula `=G{r}/E{r}` (Profit ÷ Revenue) for each product row
- **`H10`**: `=G10/E10` — overall margin for the TOTAL row (total profit ÷ total revenue)
- All margin cells use a `0.0%` percentage format; column H width set for readability

## Example results (as computed by Excel)

| Row | Product | Revenue | Profit | Margin |
|-----|---------|--------:|-------:|-------:|

| 4 | Widget B / North | 3,375 | 1,275 | 37.8% |
| 6 | Gadget X / North | 4,950 | 2,200 | 44.4% |
| 8 | Service Plan / North | 5,970 | 4,470 | 74.9% |
| 10 | TOTAL | 45,815 | 23,930 | 52.2% |

## Notes

- Formulas were used (not hardcoded values), so the margin column updates automatically if Revenue/Profit inputs change.
- No division-by-zero or other formula errors: every revenue cell is non-zero.
